policies.text: European market authorization requires a device to hold CE mark certification.
Regulatory compliance recognition is granted to a device that receives technical safety verification.
National healthcare catalog placement is authorized for a device holding regulatory compliance recognition together with a warranty coverage period of at least 2 years.
Global export licensing requires a minimum annual liability protection level of 2000000 dollars.
Commercial retail channel authorization is granted to a supplier maintaining an annual customer satisfaction rating of at least 85 percent.

Technical safety verification is approved when a device maintains a battery run time of at least 18 hours, a clinical study size of at least 400 subjects per year, a manufacturing defect rate of 0.05 defects per unit per year or lower, and holds ISO 13485 quality certification.
Extended service durability designation applies to a product with an operational lifespan of at least 4 years.
Expedited market access is granted to a device with a testing volume of at least 1000 units per year.
